body:
## Pull request overview

This is a chore/release PR that performs a patch version bump from `3.1.0` to `3.1.1` across all 38 packages in the ObjectUI monorepo's fixed changeset group, auto-generating per-package `CHANGELOG.md` entries. The `@object-ui/site` package is correctly excluded per the `.changeset/config.json` ignore list.

**Changes:**
- Version field bumped from `3.1.0` → `3.1.1` in every in-scope `package.json`
- Auto-generated `## 3.1.1` CHANGELOG entries added to all bumped packages, listing updated transitive dependencies

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 76 out of 76 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/types/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump `@object-ui/types` to 3.1.1; root package with no dependency updates |
| `packages/core/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump `@object-ui/core` to 3.1.1; depends on types |
| `packages/i18n/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump `@object-ui/i18n` to 3.1.1; empty changelog entry (no own changes) |
| `packages/react/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump `@object-ui/react` to 3.1.1; lists types, core, i18n as updated deps |
| `packages/components/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump `@object-ui/components` to 3.1.1; lists types, core, react as updated deps |
| `packages/fields/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump `@object-ui/fields` to 3.1.1; depends on types, components, core |
| `packages/layout/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump `@object-ui/layout` to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/data-objectstack/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump data adapter to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/cli/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump CLI plugin to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/create-plugin/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump scaffolding tool to 3.1.1; empty changelog entry |
| `packages/runner/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump app runner to 3.1.1; lists all its dependencies |
| `packages/auth/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump auth package to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/tenant/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump tenant package to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/permissions/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump permissions package to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/mobile/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump mobile package to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/collaboration/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump collaboration package to 3.1.1 |
| `packages/plugin-*/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` (×14) | All plugin packages bumped to 3.1.1 with appropriate dep lists |
| `packages/vscode-extension/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump VSCode extension to 3.1.1 |
| `apps/console/package.json` + `CHANGELOG.md` | Bump console app to 3.1.1; empty changelog entry |
</details>

The CHANGELOG entries for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/create-plugin`, and `@object-ui/console` only contain an empty `## 3.1.1` header with no `### Patch Changes` subsection or description. This is inconsistent with nearly every other package in this PR, which includes at minimum a "Patch Changes / Updated dependencies" entry. Even if these packages have no own changes, the convention across this monorepo is to include a `### Patch Changes` section with "Updated dependencies" or similar text. The empty entries make it look like version bumps happened for no reason, which could confuse consumers using the changelog to understand what changed.
```suggestion

### Patch Changes

- Updated dependencies
```

The `## 3.1.1` entry for `@object-ui/create-plugin` is empty (no `### Patch Changes` subsection). This is inconsistent with other packages in the same PR that include at minimum "Updated dependencies" under a `### Patch Changes` heading. Since this package is bumped only due to the fixed changeset group (not due to direct or transitive changes), this creates an uninformative changelog entry.
```suggestion

### Patch Changes

- Internal dependency alignment with the fixed changeset release group; no functional changes in this package.
```

The `## 3.1.1` entry for `@object-ui/console` is empty (no `### Patch Changes` subsection). This is inconsistent with other packages in the same PR that include at minimum "Updated dependencies" under a `### Patch Changes` heading. Consumers relying on this CHANGELOG to understand what changed between 3.1.0 and 3.1.1 will find no useful information here.
```suggestion

### Patch Changes

- Updated dependencies
```

All package CHANGELOGs in this PR skip from version `3.0.3` directly to `3.1.1`, with no `## 3.1.0` entry anywhere in the repository. The PR description states this is a bump from `3.1.0 → 3.1.1`, meaning `3.1.0` was previously released but never recorded in any CHANGELOG. The missing `3.1.0` entries make it impossible for consumers to know what changed in that release. This gap should be addressed: either by adding retroactive `## 3.1.0` sections documenting what was changed in that release, or by including a note about the unreleased gap. While this problem predates this PR, the current PR adds `3.1.1` entries that jump over the undocumented `3.1.0`, compounding the gap.
